QuestInfo.name: [Erel Light] The Soft Light
QuestInfo.0: The sparkling starlight reflecting from the length has empowered you... You can face those monsters now!
QuestInfo.1: You defeated the monsters thanks to the power of the light. Where did it come from? There's no time to find out--you better get back to the others.
QuestInfo.2: #p9201717# said that you might be the chosen of the Star Creator...and also mentioned that no one has seen #p9201716#, who has vanished as if he disappeared into thin air.
